name: Bus Girl ~Geki - Dai Enkai Ryojou Hen~
original_name: バスガール～激・大宴会旅情編～
source:
One year ago main character abandoned his hometown and his lover to chase his dream in a Tokyo company. As the season of travel comes the company employees go on a bus trip. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一年前，主角抛下故乡和恋人，前往东京的公司追逐梦想。旅行季到来时，公司员工一起乘坐巴士出游。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
